items.headline: Jon Rahm PGA Tour Return
items.text: Jon Rahm has reportedly agreed terms to return to the PGA Tour in 2027 and will make his final LIV Golf appearance this week.

items.headline: DeChambeau Open Penalty Controversy
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau's penalty at The Open Championship sparked major debate after a controversial incident at Royal Birkdale.
